commentary: The Indian market snapped its three-day advance as Nifty 50 drifted 0.61% to 25,144.30 against a cautious breadth score of 45. In Stan Weinstein's framework, broad-market deterioration coupled with October CPI spiking to 6.09% warns that overall market health is under distribution pressure. William O'Neil insisted that three out of four equities track the general index; therefore, defensive breadth demands aggressive capital preservation and strict gate discipline. With crude elevated near $95 and macro headwinds resurfacing, selective exposure must be strictly reserved for Stage 2 leaders exhibiting clean VCP contractions and confirmed institutional sponsorship, while avoiding names with decelerating or negative fundamentals.

analysis.analyst: CANSLIM (O'Neil) / SEPA (Minervini) / Stage Analysis (Weinstein) / Box Breakout (Darvas)

63MOONS.technical: Forming a rounded double-bottom base with a 10.5% handle. Price holds above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 63, but lacks confirmed Stage 2 momentum.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated earnings remain heavily unprofitable with negative margins and subdued multi-year sales growth. Low interest coverage and lack of sustained institutional demand disqualify it under CANSLIM.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis invalidates below 886.75; cut losses immediately if swing low breaches the 50-day moving average.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Cleared 20-session high to mark new trailing-year highs with RSI at 70, retaining trend template alignment above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction and negative earnings growth fail O'Neil's C-criterion. Operating margins remain thin at ~1.5% with low ROE of 3%, lacking institutional accumulation.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below 104.62; rapid stop-out needed if 20-day breakout reverses on volume.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Near breakout within 1.5% of 20-session pivot (513.51), resting constructively above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with bullish MACD and two aligned swing lows.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Consolidated Q2 PAT surged 83.3% YoY to Rs 82.8 crore, driven by margin expansion to 16.6% across API and formulations, backed by ROCE near 12% and manageable debt.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Breach below 455.37 voids the setup; enforce strict 7-8% loss discipline from pivot.

AARTIPHARM.technical: High-volume SEPA breakout clearing 20-session high and 52-week peak at 1,003.4 on 2.96x volume. Strong relative strength and classic Stage 2 base-clearance.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Standout CANSLIM profile with Q2 operational revenue surging 46.8% YoY and PAT jumping over 160% YoY, supported by 22.2% EBITDA margin and robust Xanthine/CDMO pipeline.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis collapses below 907.75; exit without hesitation if the breakout bar reverses completely.

ABB.technical: Consolidating near 20-session pivot (7,706.7) on 1.69x volume. Solid moving-average stack above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD confirming upside pressure.
ABB.fundamental: Q3CY26 profit rose 11% YoY to Rs 440 crore with revenue up 19.4% on record orders. Clean debt-free balance sheet, 29.9% ROCE, but EPS growth falls short of the 25% CANSLIM threshold.
ABB.risk: Invalidated below 7,291.91; honour stop discipline if post-earnings base fails to hold support.

ABDL.technical: Poised 1.5% below 768.77 pivot on 1.45x volume. Clean ascending pattern above all key moving averages with positive momentum divergence.
ABDL.fundamental: Q2 FY27 sales grew 15.9% YoY to Rs 1,148 crore with net profit up 9.7% YoY. ROCE stands at 18.4%, but sub-10% EPS growth and elongated debtor days cap fundamental momentum.
ABDL.risk: Breakdown below 714.10 triggers exit; preserve capital if neckline fails to confirm.
